entities.name: Gisa Cecani
entities.description: A black-aligned necromancer from Innistrad and one of its most powerful ghoulcallers, who wages a rivalry with her twin brother Geralf.

entities.name: Geralf Cecani
entities.description: Gisa's twin brother, a necromancer with grand ambitions who creates skaabs and sets formal rules for their war.

entities.name: Innistrad
entities.description: The plane from which the Cecani twins come.

entities.name: Mikaeus
entities.description: The former Lunarch of Thraben and a distant relative of the Cecani twins, killed by Geralf and brought back as a zombie by Liliana.

entities.name: Thraben
entities.description: The city from which the Cecani twins were banished, later besieged by Geralf and Gisa and eventually taken over by Gisa.

entities.name: The Moorland
entities.description: The area where the twins waged war with undead armies, leaving it desolate.

entities.name: The Nearheath
entities.description: The area to which many Moorland inhabitants moved to escape the twins' battles.

entities.name: Trostad
entities.description: A place Geralf took over and Gisa then attacked, starting NecroWarfare.

entities.name: NecroWarfare
entities.description: The war between Gisa and Geralf in which each raised undead armies against the other.

entities.name: The Five Laws of NecroWarfare
entities.description: Formal rules Geralf tried to set for the twins' undead war, which Gisa ignored.

entities.name: The Bloodletter
entities.description: A magical sword Gisa retrieved during the war.

entities.name: Liliana Vess
entities.description: A planeswalker who brought Mikaeus back as a zombie, caused the sundering of the Helvault, and left behind a zombie army that Gisa later took.

entities.name: Odric
entities.description: A champion of the church who captured Gisa and held her in Rider's Lock.

entities.name: Rider's Lock
entities.description: The prison where Gisa was held by Odric.

entities.name: The Helvault
entities.description: A construct whose sundering was caused by Liliana.

entities.name: Ludevic
entities.description: An alchemist under whose wing Geralf created his masterpiece.

entities.name: Nahiri
entities.description: A lithomancer who became Gisa's friend; Gisa provided ghouls to build the Drownyard temple.

entities.name: Drownyard
entities.description: A temple built using ghouls provided by Gisa.

entities.name: Eldrazi
entities.description: Hordes that invaded Innistrad, against whom Gisa and Geralf briefly teamed up.

entities.name: Emrakul
entities.description: The Eldrazi titan whose sealing ended the Eldrazi invasion of Innistrad.

entities.name: Wilhelt
entities.description: An undead suitor of Gisa who begged to be acknowledged as more than an undead pawn and was defeated by her.

entities.name: Havengul
entities.description: The place where Geralf's lab is located.

entities.name: Engelturm
entities.description: A structure left behind by the angels that Gisa took over.

entities.name: Jeleva
entities.description: A vampire who learned that devouring Gisa's mind would damage her own and told local vampires to avoid Gisa.

entities.name: New Phyrexia
entities.description: The Phyrexian forces that invaded Innistrad and were defeated by the twins.

entities.name: Thunder Junction
entities.description: The plane the twins reached through Omenpaths to join Oko's crew.

entities.name: Oko
entities.description: The leader of the crew that Gisa and Geralf joined on Thunder Junction.

entities.name: Kellan
entities.description: A member of Oko's crew.

entities.name: Nolan
entities.description: An archaeologist extracted from a guarded train by Oko's crew.

entities.name: Ashiok
entities.description: The benefactor of the heist who gleaned knowledge from Nolan's mind; in truth Jace Beleren under an illusion.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A planeswalker who posed as Ashiok and left without paying the gang.

entities.name: Maag Taranau
entities.description: The destination to which a map was hidden in the necropolis of Thief's Folly.

entities.name: Thief's Folly
entities.description: A necropolis on Thunder Junction where Gisa triggered a trap.

entities.name: Stella Lee
entities.description: An Atiin nomad who helped the siblings disable a zombie abomination.

entities.name: Tarnation
entities.description: The city on Thunder Junction where the vault was located.

events.summary: The Cecani twins are banished from Thraben in a scandal and move to the Moorland, where they wage war with undead armies.
events.quote: They were banished from Thraben in a hushed scandal and moved to the Moorland

events.summary: Geralf takes over Trostad and Gisa attacks it just to best her brother, starting NecroWarfare.
events.quote: Gisa attacked Trostad simply to best her brother, starting what they called "NecroWarfare".

events.summary: Geralf tries to set formal rules for the war, which Gisa ignores.
events.quote: Geralf had tried to set formal rules, named The Five Laws of NecroWarfare :

events.summary: Geralf starts the siege of Thraben and invites Gisa along, ending their engagement; he sneaks into the city to kill Mikaeus.
events.quote: Geralf snuck into the city before the attack to kill Mikaeus .

events.summary: Liliana brings Mikaeus back as a zombie.
events.quote: Later he met up with Liliana , who shortly thereafter brought Mikaeus back as a zombie .

events.summary: Gisa abandons the siege after being pushed back by fire, and Odric captures her and imprisons her in Rider's Lock.
events.quote: Odric , a champion of the church, captured Gisa and held her imprisoned in Rider's Lock.

events.summary: Liliana causes the sundering of the Helvault.
events.quote: Shortly afterwards, Liliana caused the sundering of the Helvault .

events.summary: Geralf sends skaabs to free Gisa, who says she did not need his help; she retreats to her parents' manor and revives them as zombies.
events.quote: Geralf sent a horde of skaabs to set his sister free, although she stated afterward that she didn't need his help.

events.summary: Gisa befriends Nahiri and provides ghouls to build the Drownyard temple.
events.quote: She found a new friend in the lithomancer Nahiri and provided the ghouls to build the Drownyard temple.

events.summary: Gisa and Geralf briefly team up against the Eldrazi that invaded Innistrad.
events.quote: Gisa and Geralf briefly managed to put their differences aside to team up against the Eldrazi.

events.summary: Two years after Emrakul's sealing, Gisa takes control of Liliana's abandoned zombie army and makes Thraben her own.
events.quote: Gisa took control of Liliana's abandoned zombie army and made Thraben her own

events.summary: Gisa easily defeats the army of her suitor Wilhelt, forcing him to leave.
events.quote: Gisa easily defeated Wilhelt's army, forcing him to leave.

events.summary: Gisa joins Geralf's lab in Havengul, is forced out, and takes over the Engelturm.
events.quote: She took over the Engelturm left behind by the angels.

events.summary: The siblings join forces against the Phyrexian invasion of Innistrad and defeat New Phyrexia's forces, then return to their rivalry.
events.quote: the two siblings joined forces once again, defeating the forces of New Phyrexia.

events.summary: Gisa and Geralf travel through Omenpaths to Thunder Junction and become part of Oko's crew.
events.quote: Gisa and her brother traveled through Omenpaths to Thunder Junction , becoming part of Oko 's crew.

events.summary: Gisa summons ghouls too early, and the plan to extract Nolan from the train spirals out of control, though Nolan is extracted and the gang survives.
events.quote: Nonetheless, Nolan was successfully extracted and the entire gang survived.

events.summary: Gisa triggers a trap in Thief's Folly, and with Stella Lee's help she and Geralf disable the zombie abomination and secure the map.
events.quote: Gisa accidentally triggered a trap and unleashed a zombie abomination that chased after the siblings.

events.summary: Ashiok is revealed to be Jace Beleren under an illusion, who planeswalks away without paying the gang; Gisa offers to team up with Oko again.
events.quote: they revealed themself to be Jace Beleren under an illusion and planeswalked away without paying the gang.
